_meta.description: Seed catalog of released BAdIs available in S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition (key user via Custom Logic app, or developer via ADT). Last expanded: 2026-08-04 covering all major modules. Curated starting set, NOT authoritative.
authoritative_sources: SAP Help — List of BAdIs (Public Cloud): https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_CLOUD/a630d57fc5004c6383e7a81efee7a8bb/7364d84e76e745df91f1413339a7e293.html
Custom Logic app (Fiori, key user) in your tenant — lists exactly the BAdIs available to YOUR release
ADT Released Objects tree (developer extensibility, release contract C1)
SAP Business Accelerator Hub > S/4HANA Cloud > Business Add-Ins
_meta.verification_rule: BAdI availability differs by release and scope item activation. ALWAYS confirm on the SAP Help 'List of BAdIs', the Custom Logic app, or ADT before committing a design. If an entry is not found there, it does not exist for your tenant.
